premises.text: Hearing loss is widespread and under-treated; traditional hearing aids are burdensome, costly, and stigmatizing
premises.evidence_span: 650 million people worldwide can't. They're suffering of hearing loss. And only 1 out of 40 gets treated

premises.text: A smartphone app runs calibrated audiology tests so users can assess hearing at home
premises.evidence_span: we took the whole audiology setup and process and squeezed it into a smartphone

premises.text: The phone's mic, processor, and speakers generate personalized hearing enhancement for digital audio and ambient sound
premises.evidence_span: The smartphone has all the components of a hearing aid. It has a microphone. It has a processor and it has speakers

premises.text: A dedicated smart hearing enhancer uses the phone only for initial setup and occasional fine-tuning
premises.evidence_span: we're developing a dedicated smart hearing enhancer where the phone is only used for the initial setup and for fine tuning from time to time

premises.text: Cloud-connected settings enable remote changes with guidance, and multi-user data improves the fitting algorithm
premises.evidence_span: you connect it to the cloud and that enables you to change the settings wherever and whenever while getting guidance from MIMI

premises.text: Monetization is free basic app, paid cloud premium, and subscription dedicated earpiece
premises.evidence_span: The basic version of the app is for free. The premium version with the cloud support comes for $5 a month

value.text: Make hearing enhancement more accessible, affordable, and attractive by lowering the entry barrier into everyday life
value.evidence_span: making hearing enhancement more accessible by really lowering the entry barrier for people like my father by bringing it into the living room

causal_links.evidence_span: show him directly the benefits of hearing better again
we make it more affordable and better by optimizing the distribution and fitting process
We have a clear path to monetization
